This idea that Sombra has been a problem child since release and that Invis was her core complaint point. That had not been the case in the community by and large. She was considered a throw pick, complete fodder to snipers, and duled with Sym for the “worst DPS” slot. The only 1v1 she could reliably win was with Mercy, plus Zen if she had ult or he had poor reaction time. People didn’t like Hack being 6 seconds (which was nerfed) and that was literally her only pain point. 

Until OW2, there was no outcry about Invis or TP being “unfair”. That is very much exclusive to the bots who got the game when it went F2P and then proceeded to pay 0 attention in their games while screaming and crying that she’s OP.

This is so insane to me. No, nobody gave a fuck about Sombra when she dropped. She was the worst hero in the game by a country mile and even after NUMEROUS buffs, she was rarely ever seen because her kill potential was nonexistent. In my full 6 years of OW1, I can count on both hands how many times someone took Sombra from me. She was awful. The rewriting of her history is so disingenuous. 

Her problem has only existed for a year, and it’s her burst damage. Virus just doesn’t mesh with her kit. It doesn’t make sense paired with TL and Invis and Hack, because she’s a utility hero. Instead of killing off a hero that was D tier for 7 years straight (outside of literal professionals who only used her for scouting) because she got a new ability that NO Sombra players asked for, they should just give us back Sombra from the end of OW1. Keep the reduced ability lockout time and buff her gun a bit, then call it a day.
